headline: Revenue and profit climb sharply; swing from prior-year loss
summary_short: Merdeka Copper Gold's stored revenue was 858.3M, up 9.7% q/q and 98.5% y/y, with net income of 55.6M against a loss of 19.0M a year earlier.
summary_long: Revenue of 858.3M compares with 782.1M last quarter and 432.5M a year ago. Gross profit of 281.8M implies a gross margin near 32.8%, versus about 27.7% last quarter. EBITDA was 281.4M versus 152.4M last quarter. Net income was 55.6M versus 44.1M last quarter and a loss of 19.0M a year ago. EPS was 0.0022.
